# Original CSS Parallax star background

Author: Saransh Sinha (sarazond / @screenshake).
Original: https://codepen.io/sarazond/pen/LYGbwj
Live demo: https://codepen.io/sarazond/full/LYGbwj
Public Pens MIT policy: https://blog.codepen.io/documentation/licensing/

`original-compiled.css` is the exact CSS read from the official live demo iframe
on 2026-10-26, SHA256:
62689a010b0c41f3476e9502ac656af35d1fe193022df690f427cb88cb6c75b2
`original.sass` is a source transcription for reference, not byte-identical.

`parallax-stars.css` retains all six box-shadow lists exactly, 700/200/100
white 1/2/3px points and matching after copies, with 50/100/150s motion.
No regenerated random points, bitmap, JS renderer, opacity reduction or blur.
Integration only: selectors scoped, demo title omitted, fixed clipped viewport
instead of locking document scrolling. Original 2000px fields repeat for wide
or tall monitors. OS reduced-motion preference disables decorative animation.
